hints.title: Trailing Zero Invariant
hints.text: A positive integer loses its magnitude under double reversal if and only if it ends with a zero.

hints.title: Single Zero Edge Case
hints.text: Zero itself is preserved under reversal and yields true.

hints.title: Direct Modular Verification
hints.text: Return true when num equals zero or when num modulo ten is non-zero.

hints.title: Complete Implementation

complexity.notes: Reversing a number with trailing zeros loses those zeros, preventing identical double reversal unless num is 0.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Converting numbers to strings and reversing twice adds unnecessary allocations.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Constant time check num == 0 or num % 10 != 0 achieves instant evaluation.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate should recognize that trailing zeros are lost upon the first reversal.
